author: @onkardeshpande1131
text: In the RAG example for legal company which you showcased in other video, your team developed custom retrieval technique. why you haven't used vectorless RAG(reasoning page index) ?

author: @srikanthdongala-ai
text: great question! Vectorless RAG wasn't proven or widely adopted when we built that legal solution, but it has some positives and has overcome the drawbacks of the embeddings-based retrieval. But it does have a few real drawbacks; cost can go up significantly since LLMs are involved at retrieval time, not just generation, which also means higher latency and cost. It also works best with well-structured documents, so if the knowledge base is small or inconsistently structured, you're honestly just adding complexity for no real benefit.
